paired_design: Same source boards, potential collapse draws, calibration cells and row-indexed tie streams in both arms. One shared calibration fit per bank. Masks may differ through history; no future or unqueried values enter selection.
corruption_law: Each source board draws a Bernoulli(9/160) event and uniform digit in0..8, shared by all current queries and calibration repeats. Draw event uniform and output digit on every row, after fixing current mask. For a fixed pre-query cell, marginal error is(9/160)*(8/9)=1/20.
supplied_prior: Every completed board has at most9 occurrences of any digit. This global Sudoku balance prior is explicitly supplied; no peer graph enters the filter.
filter_rule: Query all25 selected cells, then reject the entire row iff any observed digit count exceeds9. All query costs remain charged. Rejected rows update no joint/equal evidence, exclusion or first-crossing state. Unfiltered accepts every row.
theorem_predictions: Every collapsed25-label row is rejected and every clean row accepted. Filtered accepted evidence equals a clean subsequence using original row-indexed tie draws, including RNG advancement on skipped rows. All true edges retained. These identities do not guarantee enough evidence for exact support; scalar eta calibration remains undercovered.
empirical_primary: At least29 of32 filtered supports exactly equal the true graph. Exact finite-bank target supports iff exact_count>=29, otherwise falsifies. Report unfiltered control and every outcome; no independent-edge interval or universal robustness claim.
learner: Unchanged exposure selector exponential_e,25 queries. Repeated-query CP99.5% bound on1000 indicators, outward1e-6 eta grid; q0=eta/4-9eta^2/64,q1=1/9; first crossing648000. Same threshold for clean reference and both observed arms.
independent_audits: Independently replay source draws and CSV answers; exact row collapse RNG; Counter-based filter check uses only25 observed labels; postfit source digit multiplicities; Decimal80 calibration endpoint/predecessor and thresholds; every mask/noise/LR/first crossing. Separate clean reference filtered state with row-indexed RNG advancement even for rejected rows. Verify state unchanged on rejected rows and equality of all clean-reference states.
budget: At most900 aggregate CPU seconds and180 wall seconds for preparation, acquisition, audits and summary, up to8 CPU workers. Threads1. Live process CPU/wall counters terminate only owned subprocesses at budget exhaustion. No extensions or GPU work.
stopping_rule: Exactly32 fresh paired banks,64 new acquisitions and32 shared calibrations; retain all draws and outcomes. No solver cohort.
limitations: Explicitly supplied global digit-balance prior; not a graph-free learned guarantee in arbitrary tasks.
Filtering is specific to detectable shared collapse; other correlated noise can evade it.
Perfect filtering does not guarantee exact support with fewer accepted samples.
No solver accuracy or certification experiment. BP AdamW outside this source-only study; not run.
